This ensures all verification transactions are recorded with precise and trustworthy time data.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full flex-col items-start gap-6 self-stretch"><h5 class="second-head font-semibold text-foreground">Distributed Ledger Technology (Blockchain)</h5><div class="box-border flex w-full items-start gap-8 self-stretch border-b border-[#E1E1D8] pb-10"><img alt="pki" width="134" height="134" class="size-[134px] shrink" src="/assets/dlt-B_3ksvtt.svg"><div class="flex grow flex-col items-start gap-8"><p class="desc">NINAuth uses Distributed Ledger Technology as a resilient backup for storing verification transaction records.
